summary: THE LAST SIGNAL is an interactive storytelling website that brings the stories of space exploration hardware to students and young learners. Through illustrated stories, NASA photographs and interactive 3D equipment explorers, visitors learn about machines left on the Moon and Mars, alongside missions still exploring space. The project turns technical mission information into approachable stories, connecting what each machine did with why it matters. NASA resources support the mission facts, while generated illustrations provide atmosphere rather than evidence. Our aim is to make space history easier to understand, encourage curiosity about engineering and preserve the stories of machines that continued humanity's journey beyond Earth.
details:
THE LAST SIGNAL presents space exploration history as an interactive digital archive. Visitors can browse missions, read illustrated stories and explore educational 3D equipment models with labelled parts. Completed or lost missions are separated from ongoing exploration, helping visitors understand the difference between a machine's mission ending and its historical value.

The experience is designed for students and young learners. Short explanations, visual storytelling and interactive equipment views make technical information more approachable. NASA mission resources provide the factual foundation; atmospheric illustrations support the storytelling and should not be interpreted as real mission photographs.

The website uses React, TypeScript and Vite, with React Router for navigation and Three.js for interactive 3D content. GitHub holds the source code and Vercel hosts the website.

Its creative approach combines the feeling of a museum archive with picture-book storytelling. Instead of presenting only dates and specifications, it invites visitors to explore the purpose, achievements and legacy of the machines.

We considered factual accuracy, clear source attribution, accessible language and the distinction between real photographs, generated illustrations and educational models. The 3D models are learning aids, not exact flight-engineering CAD. THE LAST SIGNAL is an independent student project and is not endorsed by NASA.
